name: self.fold
description: Marks a span of the run log for folding, optionally limited to one content kind, and keeps the raw steps until the fold lands.
example: await self.fold([3, 9], { note: "keep the failing test names" });

host.description: Marks a span of the attached run as pending; compaction leaves its raw steps untouched until a batch lands. With `kind`, it folds only that kind of content in each step: `repl_output` folds the console and keeps the program and its result handles; `program` folds the program text and keeps its speech calls and console.
